api.unexpected: An unexpected server error occurred. Contact the system administrator.
api.concurrentUpdate: Another user has updated this record. Reload it before saving.
api.databaseUpdateFailed: The database update failed. Contact the system administrator.
api.foreignKey: Other records reference this data. Remove those records or their links before continuing.
api.validationFailed: The input is invalid. Check the field values.
api.network: Cannot connect to the backend API. Check that the service is running at {baseUrl}, then refresh this page.
api.unauthorized: Unauthorized (401). If sign-in is enabled, sign in to obtain a Token.
api.conflict: Other records reference this data. Remove the related child records or their links before continuing.
api.forbidden: Permission denied (403). Viewers can only view and query data.
api.environmentMismatch: Safety check blocked the request: WEB is {webEnvironment} and API is {apiEnvironment}. Writes are prohibited because the environments differ.
